tasks.title: OO chrome parity: File/Home/Insert tabs merged into the first row next to the WorldOffice logo, light-gray function band, single left-to-right group flow with chevron overflow buttons when the viewport is limited
tasks.accept: cd apps/web/apps/documenteditor-wysiwyg && for t in *.test.mjs; do node "$t" > /dev/null || { echo "FAIL $t"; exit 1; }; done && node scripts/chrome-probe.mjs > /tmp/chrome1.log 2>&1; grep -q 'chrome-probe: ALL GREEN' /tmp/chrome1.log && echo CHROME-OK
tasks.acceptance_prose:
USER REQUEST (verbatim intent): 'file home insert and so on should be in the very first row next to the WorldOffice Logo with buttons to let the elements flow from left to right, if viewport is limited. OnlyOffice has a light gray area with all the functions.'

This restructures the chrome to the OO shape: ONE title row (logo + tab strip + quick access), then a light-gray function band whose groups flow in a single horizontal line and scroll via chevron buttons when clipped.

CURRENT STRUCTURE (index.html lines ~127-230, style.css ~100-180):
- .titlebar (gold band y0-28): wordmark + doc-name + btn-save + btn-undo-tb + spacer + fullscreen
- #menu-bar (28px row): btn-print-qa, user-chip, btn-redo-qa  → DELETE this row, move its children into the title row right side (keep all ids)
- header#toolbar > .ribbon-tabs (tab strip incl. #btn-file File trigger first) + .ribbon-page[data-tab] groups (.ribbon-page.active is flex-wrap:wrap, band min-height 112, overflow-x: clip)

TARGET STRUCTURE:
1. ROW 1 = .titlebar (light theme: light gray like OO classic-light #F7F7F7-family; dark theme keeps its gray): [wordmark logo] [.ribbon-tabs (File trigger + 11 tabs)] [spacer] [doc-name] [user-chip] [btn-print-qa] [btn-redo-qa] [btn-save] [btn-undo-tb] [fullscreen]. Move the .ribbon-tabs div + File menu (ribbon-file menu) INTO .titlebar after the wordmark; delete nav#menu-bar entirely (its children move). Tabs keep role=tablist/tab, aria-selected, hidden-tab behavior (contextual tabs stay hidden until object selection), and ALL existing classes/ids/data-cmd — census probes count .ribbon-tab elements (12 tabs) and controls (198); do not lose or rename any. Tab strip height ~28-32px, vertically centered, gap ~2px. Active tab style: filled contrast pill (white in light theme) like OO; inactive hover subtle.
2. ROW 2 = function band (header#toolbar without the tab strip): background var(--ribbon) set to OO classic-light light-gray (#f7f7f7 family — check the existing --ribbon var and the light-theme palette; adjust LIGHT theme value to OO gray; keep dark theme equivalent). Border-bottom 1px. min-height ~84px single row.
3. .ribbon-page.active: flex-wrap: NOwrap — one horizontal line of groups left→right, align-items center, no wrapping. Groups keep .rb-sep separators.
4. OVERFLOW CHEVRONS (the core request): implement scroll-by-translation, NOT a scroll container — CSS makes overflow-x:auto force overflow-y to auto (clips the absolutely-positioned .menu-list dropdowns that hang below the band; the current CSS deliberately uses overflow-x:clip + overflow-y:visible, see comments). Mechanism: keep the band as the clip viewport; add a JS-managed horizontal offset applied as transform:translateX(-Npx) to the active .ribbon-page's inner content (wrap content in a .ribbon-flow inner div or transform the page itself — pick the one that keeps dropdowns attached under their triggers; position:absolute dropdowns inside the transformed subtree move WITH it, which is correct). Two chevron buttons ‹ › absolutely positioned at the band's right edge (both stacked or edge-split — OO/Word style: › appears when content overflows right, ‹ when offset>0), class rib-scroll-btn, aria-labels from NEW i18n keys Toolbar.ScrollLeft/Toolbar.ScrollRight (ADD to BOTH en and de: 'Scroll toolbar left'/'Symbolleiste nach links scrollen' etc.). Click: offset ±0.8*band width, clamped [0, max]. Wheel over band: deltaY scrolls offset. Offset resets to 0 on tab switch and on resize recompute. Chevrons hidden (display:none) when the active page fits. Recompute on window resize + after font/zoom changes if cheap. Keyboard: chevrons are real <button>s (focusable, Enter works).
5. Collapsed ribbon (.toolbar.ribbon-collapsed) keeps working: tabs stay in row 1, band hidden.
6. Do not break: backstage/File overlay, contextual tab activation (chart-design/draw/table-layout hidden tabs), right-panel rp-open layout, statusbar, theme switching (applyTheme), locale switching (applyLocale re-seeds — any new chrome strings must be i18n'd both languages).

DELIVERABLES:
1. index.html: restructured rows (titlebar with tabs+qa, no #menu-bar), chevron buttons, new i18n keys en+de in i18n.js.
2. editor.js: chevron scroll logic (offset state, update function, event wiring, resize observer or window resize listener, tab-switch reset), any moved wiring (menu-bar removal must not orphan listeners — grep btn-print-qa/btn-redo-qa/user-chip handlers).
3. style.css: row-1 styles, gray band vars (light + dark), nowrap flow, chevron styles, collapsed state, responsive tweaks.
4. scripts/chrome-probe.mjs (RECIPE: http.server port 18052, playwright via require('/home/weiss/git/World-Office/wo-test-harness/census/node_modules/playwright'), domcontentloaded + 2500ms, chromium.launch({args:['--no-sandbox']})): asserts (a) wordmark and File tab share a row (|y difference| < 8) and File is the first tab; (b) band computed background is light gray in light theme (parse rgb(), each channel within 235-255); (c) 900px viewport: › visible on Home, clicking shifts content (transform/scrollLeft proxy changes), ‹ becomes visible after scroll, clamped at max; (d) 1440px viewport Home: chevrons hidden; (e) dropdown open at 900px (font-family or any .rb-menu) fully visible below band (bottom <= viewport height); (f) tab count still 12, census-visible controls on Home unchanged; (g) 0 pageerrors. Print 'chrome-probe: ALL GREEN' only if every check passes.
5. chrome-gate.test.mjs: static pins — .titlebar contains .ribbon-tabs AND #btn-file; #menu-bar absent; chevron buttons exist in markup; i18n has Toolbar.ScrollLeft/Right in en AND de; .ribbon-page.active nowrap rule present; .rb-sep still styled.
6. Update ANY existing *.test.mjs that pinned the old three-row structure (grep titlebar/menu-bar/ribbon-tabs across tests first).
7. cargo/n.a. Commit incrementally (markup move → CSS → chevrons → probe → gate), message prefix 'feat(CHROME1-TITLE-TAB-ROW)'.

Worktree layout: you are at the monorepo root; paths above are relative to it.
